_scenario_name: Pelaut Maritime — IN parent, Singapore Ops Head exercises options
_narrative: Pelaut Maritime Ltd is Mumbai-headquartered. Their Operations Head — a Singapore tax resident — was granted 50,000 options at $2 strike during her Singapore employment. FMV at exercise is $4. She exercises 20,000 on 1 May 2026. Reverse cross-border: IRAS overseas-parent rule attaches SG tax.
